newsitem.title: USA: Texaco completes sale of plant to Huntsman.
newsitem.headline: Texaco completes sale of plant to Huntsman.

text.p: Texaco Inc said Friday that it has completed the sale of its propylene oxide/methyl tertiary butyl ether (PO/MTBE) business to a subsidiary of Huntsman Corporation, for approximately $600 million.

The PO/MTBE manufacturing site, located adjacent to Huntsman facilities in Port Neches, Texas, has a production capacity of approximately 400 million pounds per year of propylene oxide and approximately 15,000 barrels per day of MTBE. Huntsman said it has operated the plant for Texaco since it began operations in August 1994.

Huntsman also said it had acquired Texaco's exclusive, state-of-the art PO/MTBE manufacturing technology, including the right to license the technology around the world. Texaco and Huntsman have agreed to a long-term MTBE supply agreement to ensure Texaco a stable source of the gasoline additive.
The deal was announced in December.
